subject: Service integrity concerns & request for premium path ahead of renewal
messages:
From: Claire Bishop <claire@fintrust.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinTrust SRE Team <ops@fintrust.com>, Mark Lewis <mark.lewis@fintrust.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Ongoing latency spikes — need commercial path before renewal

Evelyn —

Quick note from our SREs: we saw a cluster of latency spikes across peak windows the week of Sep 6–12. This has materially affected some user flows in our onboarding funnel (5–7% higher p95 on inference calls). Renewal for our annual contract is approaching (Nov 1), and the finance team is pausing the renewal conversation until we get a clear remediation and confidence plan.

Can Redwood propose a commercial path that includes stronger uptime/latency commitments (a premium SLA or pilot on reserved capacity) plus a short-term credit for the incidents while we evaluate? We’d like an internal proposal by end of next week if possible.

Mark from our side is on copy for SRE details. I can share the incident logs once we agree on an NDA/secure transfer.

Thanks —
Claire
Claire Bishop
Head of Platform Operations, FinTrust
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Bishop <claire@fintrust.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ongoing latency spikes — need commercial path before renewal

Hi Claire —

Thanks for flagging this and for the detail. Sorry to hear the onboarding funnel was impacted — that’s exactly the kind of production behavior we want to prevent.

Quick plan from our side:
- Immediate: can you securely send the incident log (or a redacted sample) so our infra team can triage root causes? We prefer a secure link; if you’re comfortable, ops@redwood.ai can accept an encrypted upload.
- Commercial proposal: we can offer a 30-day pilot on a dedicated reserved pool (same network tenancy as Hosted but isolated capacity) with an SLA addendum that guarantees p95 latency targets for inference calls on the reserved pool. During the pilot we’ll instrument per-route tracing and a joint runbook.
- Credit: we can discuss a one-time service credit tied to demonstrated impact windows — I’ll loop in finance and contracts and come back with concrete numbers.

I’ve attached a draft SLA addendum (SLA_addendum_proposal_20260918.pdf) with a high-level pilot scope. If that looks reasonable, I’ll propose a timeline and a DocuSign for sign-off.

When are you available for a 30–45 minute call this week or early next week?

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Claire Bishop <claire@fintrust.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Lewis <mark.lewis@fintrust.com>, FinTrust SRE Team <ops@fintrust.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ongoing latency spikes — need commercial path before renewal

Evelyn —

Thanks for the quick reply. I’ve attached the incident export from our APM (incident_log_20260912.pdf) — it includes traces and the associated request patterns. The two high-severity spikes were during our 11:00–13:00 PST window on Sep 9 and Sep 11.

Before we commit to a call, a few clarifying Qs so we can prep the right people:
- What is the expected monthly delta for a 30-day dedicated pilot compared to our current consumption? Ballpark numbers are fine.
- How does Redwood calculate credits for incidents that fall under the current SLA vs. the premium addendum?
- Can the pilot run in us-east-1 and be provisioned within five business days?

If you can answer those roughly in an email, we’ll scope attendees and accept a meeting invite.

Claire
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-19T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: FinTrust incident log — need commercial path (internal)

Folks — forwarding FinTrust’s incident export. High level asks: pilot on reserved pool (us-east-1), SLA addendum, one-time credit while they evaluate, provisioning within ~5 biz days. They want a proposal by next week.

Proposed commercial posture:
- Offer: 30-day dedicated reserved pool (c5-gpu equivalent), instrumentation and runbook, guaranteed p95 <= 250ms for inference endpoint under the reserved pool traffic profile.
- Credits: propose a one-time 20% credit on last month’s invoice for verified incidents, plus an optional 15% discount on the first month of the reserved pool if they commit to a 6-month reserved term after pilot.
- Timing: provisioning in 3–5 business days (need infra sign-off), DocuSign SLA addendum.

Questions:
1) Are the credit numbers too aggressive? 2) Is p95 <= 250ms achievable for the model family they use (Llama2-13B-q4)? 3) Any legal / contracts redlines we should expect?

—I’ll take infra coordination. Marissa / Rishi — finance/credit / SRE sizing please.
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-19T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: FinTrust incident log — need commercial path (internal)

Eve — quick thoughts:
- Credits: 20% one-time feels high for a single incident cluster. Recommend 10% credit on the invoiced amount for Sep + a guaranteed service credit formula in the SLA addendum (e.g., 5% monthly credit for any calendar month where uptime < 99.5% for the reserved pool). That ties behavior to measurable SLOs.
- Performance target: p95 <= 250ms is feasible with reserved pool + q4 quantization for Llama2-13B, provided request concurrency remains within the pilot profile. We should explicitly call out per-route concurrency caps in the addendum to avoid noisy neighbors.
- Provisioning: infra can commit to 4 business days if we reserve capacity now; need Marissa to confirm.
- Legal: expect standard redlines on indemnity and data residency; get Contracts to pre-author a minimal addendum to speed things up.

I’ll draft the tweak for the SLA addendum and send to Eve for approval before customer send.
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Bishop <claire@fintrust.com>, FinTrust SRE Team <ops@fintrust.com>, Mark Lewis <mark.lewis@fintrust.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed pilot + SLA addendum for FinTrust (draft attached)

Claire —

Thanks again for the incident export. Based on our triage and internal sizing, here is our formal proposal: 

Summary: 30-day dedicated reserved pool pilot (us-east-1) + SLA addendum guaranteeing reserved-pool p95 <= 250ms for inference endpoints under the pilot traffic profile.

Commercial terms (draft):
- Pilot cost: approx. $18,000 for the 30-day reserved pool (ballpark; final invoice will be usage-adjusted).
- Credit: 10% one-time credit on Sep invoices tied to verified incidents in the incident_log_20260912.pdf.
- Subsequent commitment: if FinTrust signs a 6-month reserved term within 30 days of pilot completion, Redwood will apply a 15% discount on the first month of the reserved term.
- SLA credit mechanism: automatic monthly credits if reserved-pool uptime falls below thresholds (99.5% => 5% credit; 99.0% => 10% credit).

Operational:
- Provisioning: target 4 business days after DocuSign sign-off.
- Runbook & telemetry: we’ll enable per-route tracing and a shared dashboard; weekly sync during the pilot.
- Pilot scope: endpoints for the onboarding funnel only; we will cap concurrency per route to prevent noisy neighbor effects (detailed in addendum).

Attached: SLA_addendum_proposal_20260918.pdf (draft). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/FT-2026-0043
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/FT-2026-0043/sla-addendum (draft)

If this looks OK, please reply with a brief sign-off and we’ll send the DocuSign for approval. We can also hop on a 30-minute call to walk through the addendum.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Claire Bishop <claire@fintrust.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Lewis <mark.lewis@fintrust.com>, FinTrust SRE Team <ops@fintrust.com>
Date: 2026-09-23T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed pilot + SLA addendum for FinTrust (draft attached)

Evelyn / team —

Thanks for the thorough proposal and for the quick turnaround. We reviewed internally and FinTrust is willing to proceed on the proposed terms: 30-day reserved pilot in us-east-1, 10% one-time credit for Sep (we’ll share verification notes), and the follow-on discount contingent on a 6-month commitment.

Two asks before we sign:
1) Please ensure the reserved pool is provisioned in us-east-1 (we run our production data there).
2) Can you add a clause that the pilot’s concurrency caps are adjustable based on mutual agreement during week 1 of the pilot?

We will approve the DocuSign once those two small changes are reflected. Please send an updated addendum and the DocuSign link; we’ll aim to get it signed within 24 hours of receipt.

Claire Bishop
Head of Platform Operations, FinTrust
